note: Site header and navigation -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency, Sign in, Register, and fixed service tabs (Stays, Flights, Flight+Hotel, Car rentals, Attractions, Airport taxis)
Search results breadcrumb -- renders: fixed navigation segments (e.g., Stays, City, District)
Search results summary header -- renders: fixed labels (e.g., 'Hotels in [City]') and 'Sort by' control
Filter sidebar -- renders: fixed filter group headings (e.g., 'Popular filters', 'Property Type', 'Review Score') and operator-defined filter options
Results count header -- renders: fixed label (e.g., 'Hotels in [City]')
Sort control -- renders: fixed sort options (e.g., 'Top reviewed', 'Price (lowest first)')
Site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links (e.g., 'Support', 'Careers', 'About us') and legal links
Cookie consent banner -- renders: operator-authored privacy policy text and fixed buttons (Accept, Reject, Settings)
